ARCHBISHOP FRANCIS OLATUNDE OKE : THE MAN OF GOD WITH HEAVY ANOINTING AND GRACE AT 70.

September 8 4 min read Latunde Akin

ARCHBISHOP FRANCIS OLATUNDE OKE : THE MAN OF GOD WITH HEAVY ANOINTING AND GRACE AT 70.
(By Latunde Akin)
I am privileged to be part of his first set of missionary trainee,so I have the rare previledge of close tapping of annoiting and observing his truest nature and the godly realm where he operates from.
Pa Wale Oke is a fasting machine. This year alone ,he would have fasted for 150 days if I am not understating it.
How God brought me close to him was through a dream. In that dream, I found myself in his house telling him I am ready to learn from him. In the revelation, he looked at me and discovered I was close to a powerful man of God like him. He asked who is that, and I told him. Then he said OK and pointed me to his library to go and study.
Immediately I woke,I realised I must get closer. So I started attending Advanced Ministers Seminar AMS. From there I opted to join his full-time mission training school.
Pa Wale Oke is a mystery no man can fully understand. This is because of the kind of angel guarding him.
The first research I had to make when I entered the mission school was to first understand his angels and not him. I will be behaving in a way so my teachers and others won't know I am a serious man,so they wouldn't choose me for any executive position. I knew exactly why I was in the mission school. And it actually worked for me.
Do you know, if Pa Wale Oke secretly entered the training school to rest or to teach,his angel comes to me first to inform me. And it happened everytime. I tried to find a day he comes around that his angel won't appear to me. I found none. I kept this secret at the time and you know one funny thing? Since I already enjoy such deep visitation everytime he comes around or not,I became not worried again about not physically being seen around him.
I was understudying him and everything about him apart from the mission training.
The first thing I discovered is that Pa Wale Oke isn't materialistic at all. He is a man who doesn't fancy material possession. He turned his only house into a mission training ground that can accommodate more than 100 students at a time. He doesn't use security team until he became PFN president.
He is a genuine son of God.
He is not perfect physically,infact if you look at him from afar and see his smile, you will think he's only so cool and fatherly. Yes,he is very cool to be with and at the same time very fatherly BUT he is a military man o
. Don't be carried away by his jovial simple nature,if he changes it for you,you will smell pepper
. I think this is why some people run away. He no dey take nonsense unless he chooses never to talk.
Yet you will see his heart ,so contrite,broken, humble. A heart that trembles at God's word and corrections. Forget about those titles, Pa Wale Oke isn't a fan of those titles, he is a pure disciple of Jesus Christ ,an evangelist, a prophet and a man who has suffered so much for the course of Christ.
I was in a deep financial mess during my mission training and his angel appeared to me again and told me he will help me. Normally the Angel had noticed me since I entered the training. I can carry belongings that meant so much to me and donate them, I secretly I made sacrifices without anyone knowing I did. God did actually helped me. He changed my Nissan primera then to a Lexus jeep. He built a duplex for me right as a trainee under Pa Wale Oke. He bought many landed properties for me. Which means I was actually rescued by that angel as promised. It was so glaringly surprising that some people hardly believe God can bless people while on full time training. A training that seperated us from wife and children for close to two years.
If you don't understand the Angel of the church you attend and what he demands as your consecration,please kindly find out in prayers. So you won't have to struggle following great men without understanding the kind of Power that powers them. Loyalty is good,but it mustn't be done blindly. Else it won't bear fruit.
Happy birthday to Baba Wale Oke.
May the rest of his life be spent in quantum fruitfulness more than before.
May all his great desires for God to expand His kingdom through his life become more established.
May Pa Wale Oke end well and finish strongly in Jesus name. Amen
